core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nurin is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Light, luminous”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nurin corresponds to the Arabic form نُورِين (Arabic نُور (nūr) + feminine ending). Its core sense is nurin; light, luminous. Nurin is Arabic نُورِين (Nūrīn) 'light, luminous', from نُور (nūr) 'light'. The source gloss 'Light of Faith' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is predominantly female. Same name as naureen.
